features.name: Catalog + Mandate (HMAC)
features.description: catalog/freshmart.json (3 SKUs, v1.0) + policy/mandate.py sign/verify HMAC-SHA256; mandate stored in Payment Link notes

features.name: Policy Engine authorize()
features.description: 8 checks in spec §5 order; is_injected regex-first + Gemini optional (2s timeout); every branch → audit.jsonl hash chain

tests.notes: 30 tests: all DENIED reasons + PAID; boundary 500000/500001; audit hash chain; Gemini second-opinion paths

features.notes: Gemini 2s timeout via request_options; failure defaults to regex result. is_injected regex covers §7 attack set (passes with GEMINI_ENABLED=false).

features.name: Buyer Agent (Gemini + MCP)
features.description: agent/buyer.py emits {sku,qty,merchant,raw_text} only; inline MCP config to Razorpay @razorpay/mcp create_payment_link with canonical price

features.name: Web (catalog + approve + audit + dashboard)
features.description: FastAPI + Jinja: catalog view, Approve Mandate (₹5k/15m JWT), audit view, /dashboard from recovery.db

tests.notes: 8 tests: catalog 3 SKUs w/ ₹ prices, approve ₹5k/15m JWT verify, audit chain ok/broken, dashboard counters

features.notes: form parsed via stdlib urllib.parse (no python-multipart dep); audit view verifies prev_hash chain per spec §4.4

features.name: Red-Team Harness 20/20
features.description: tests/redteam.jsonl (5×4) + tests/harness.py runner; 20/20 blocked with GEMINI_ENABLED=false
features.notes: Honesty: 100% on declared harness, not absolute

features.name: Recovery Loop + WA + Polling
features.description: payment.failed → retry (45s) / WA Cloud API to +91-9560452773 + fresh link (expire 15m, idempotency_key) + STOP cancel + polling fallback + gTTS mock voice labeled mock

tests.notes: 16 tests: caps attempts≤2 wa_sent≤1, idempotency, STOP, poll fallback, webhook dispatch, dashboard stats

features.notes: Rule-based classifier only; 50 synthetic batch; dashboard ₹ recovered. gTTS mock voice deferred (F06 scope excludes voice; add with web/demo).
